raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer agent was experiencing persistent technical failures (multiple `TimeoutError` exceptions) when attempting to access the IMDb page. Instead of adapting the strategy to rely on the successfully retrieved Wikipedia data (which already confirmed the director as Brad Silberling) or acknowledging the inability to verify via IMDb due to technical constraints, the Planner repeatedly issued identical instructions to the WebSurfer to retry the same inaccessible URL. This resulted in a circular loop of failed attempts without progressing toward a verified solution or utilizing the available correct information from the Wikipedia source.
